assessment: This paper presents a generative adversarial network-inspired model of how learning during wakefulness, non-rapid eye movement (NREM), and REM sleep work together to facilitate the emergence of object category representations. The model is impressive in its ability to shape representations based on internally generated activity that does not directly recapitulate prior experience, and has properties that correspond to replay and dreams in NREM and REM sleep. The model makes predictions that can be tested in sleep experiments in humans and animals.
